newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ ponders sale of catering unit.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ ponders sale of catering unit.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Friday it was exploring the prospect of selling its catering business.
Air NZ Catering supplies airlines in the Air NZ group and has contracts to supply 17 overseas airlines operating through New Zealand.
The unit has bases in Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch and Rarotonga, employing 480 people and producing more than 7.2 million meals a year.
The company said it was testing the market in response to a number of expressions of interest it had received from potential buyers. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
